Title: User account provisioning
Requirement: An Administrator shall create user accounts and assign exactly one role to each account; self-registered accounts shall default to the Requester role.
Acceptance criteria: Given an Administrator on the user administration screen, when a valid email and role are submitted, then an active account exists with that role and no other role, and the creation is written to the audit trail.

Title: Authentication
Requirement: The system shall authenticate a user by email address and password before granting access to any function other than sign-in and password reset.
Acceptance criteria: Given an unauthenticated visitor, when any application URL other than sign-in or password reset is requested, then access is refused and the visitor is redirected to sign-in with no request data disclosed.

Title: Role-based access control
Requirement: The system shall enforce four roles - Requester, Staff, Manager, Administrator - and permit each role only the operations authorised for it.
Acceptance criteria: Given an authenticated user in role R, when an operation not authorised for R is attempted, then the operation is refused with an authorisation error and no state change occurs.
Verification method: Automated role x operation matrix test (NFR-004)

Title: Password reset
Requirement: The system shall allow a user to reset a forgotten password through a single-use, time-limited link sent to the registered email address.
Acceptance criteria: Given a registered user requesting a reset, when the emailed link is used within its validity period, then a new password may be set; when the same link is reused or used after expiry, then it is refused.

Title: Submit a service request
Requirement: A Requester shall submit a service request capturing title, description, category and location as mandatory information.
Acceptance criteria: Given an authenticated Requester with all four mandatory fields completed, when the request is submitted, then a request is stored with a unique reference, status New, the submitter recorded and a submission timestamp; and the reference is displayed to the Requester.

Title: Controlled category selection
Requirement: The system shall require the Requester to select a category from a controlled list maintained by an Administrator, and shall reject free-text categories.
Acceptance criteria: Given the submission form, when no category is selected, then submission is refused with a field-level message; and the category selector offers only values from the active controlled list.

Title: View status of own request
Requirement: A Requester shall view the current status of any request they submitted.
Acceptance criteria: Given a Requester with at least one submitted request, when the request is opened, then the current status, the date of the last status change and any resolution note are displayed.

Title: View own request history
Requirement: A Requester shall view a list of all requests they have previously submitted, most recent first.
Acceptance criteria: Given a Requester with n submitted requests, when the request list is opened, then exactly those n requests are listed with reference, category, submission date and status, and no request belonging to another user appears.

Title: Notify requester of state change
Requirement: The system shall notify the Requester in-app and by email when their request is accepted, rejected, updated with a comment, or completed.
Acceptance criteria: Given a request owned by Requester X, when its status changes to Accepted, Rejected or Resolved, then an in-app notification and an email are generated to X within 5 minutes, containing the reference, the new status and any reason.

Title: Comment thread on a request
Requirement: An authenticated Requester and authorised Staff shall exchange comments attached to a request record; personal contact details shall not be exposed.
Acceptance criteria: Given a request with an assigned staff member, when either party adds a comment, then the comment is stored against the request with author and timestamp and is visible to both, and no email address or telephone number of the other party is displayed.

Title: Staff work queue
Requirement: A Staff user shall view the service requests they are authorised to see, including unassigned requests and requests assigned to them.
Acceptance criteria: Given a Staff user, when the queue is opened, then unassigned requests and requests assigned to that user are listed, and requests assigned to another staff member are not shown by default.

Title: Search, filter and sort
Requirement: A Staff or Manager user shall search by reference or keyword and filter and sort the request list by category, status, assignee, priority and submission date.
Acceptance criteria: Given a list of requests, when a filter or sort is applied, then only matching requests are returned in the requested order, and combining two filters returns the intersection.

Title: View full request detail
Requirement: An authorised user shall view the complete detail of a request including its full status and assignment history.
Acceptance criteria: Given an authorised user opening a request, when the detail view is displayed, then submitted information, current status, assignee, all comments and the complete ordered change history are shown.

Title: Assign, self-assign and reassign
Requirement: A Manager shall assign a request to a Staff user, a Staff user shall accept an unassigned request, and a Manager shall reassign an assigned request.
Acceptance criteria: Given an unassigned request, when a Staff user accepts it, then that user becomes the assignee and the assignment is written to the audit trail; and when a Manager reassigns it, the previous and new assignee are both recorded.

Title: Controlled status transitions
Requirement: The system shall permit only defined status transitions across New, Accepted, In Progress, On Hold, Resolved, Closed and Rejected, and shall refuse any undefined transition.
Acceptance criteria: Given a request in status Closed, when any transition other than the defined reopen path is attempted, then it is refused and the status is unchanged; and every permitted transition is recorded with actor and timestamp.
Verification method: State-transition test covering the full permitted and forbidden matrix

Title: Record action and resolution information
Requirement: An assigned Staff user shall record actions taken and shall record resolution information when moving a request to Resolved.
Acceptance criteria: Given a request being moved to Resolved, when no resolution note is supplied, then the transition is refused; when a note is supplied, the note is stored against the request with author and timestamp.

Title: Resolve and close a request
Requirement: An assigned Staff user shall move a request to Resolved, and a Manager shall move a Resolved request to Closed.
Acceptance criteria: Given a Resolved request, when a Manager closes it, then the status becomes Closed with actor and timestamp recorded; and a Staff user attempting to close it directly is refused.

Title: Reject or return a request
Requirement: A Staff or Manager user shall reject or return a request to the Requester, and the system shall require a reason.
Acceptance criteria: Given a request being rejected, when no reason is supplied, then the rejection is refused; when a reason is supplied, the request status becomes Rejected, the reason is stored and the Requester is notified (FR-009).

Title: Management activity dashboard
Requirement: A Manager shall view counts of open, in progress, overdue, resolved and closed requests for a selected period.
Acceptance criteria: Given a known data set for a period, when the dashboard is opened for that period, then each displayed count equals the count obtained directly from the stored records for that period.
Verification method: Functional test against a seeded data set

Title: Activity breakdown
Requirement: A Manager shall view request activity broken down by category, status, assignee and time period.
Acceptance criteria: Given a seeded data set, when a breakdown by category is requested, then every active category is represented and the sum of the category counts equals the total request count for the period.

Title: Overdue identification
Requirement: The system shall identify a request as overdue when its elapsed open time exceeds the configured target resolution time for its category.
Acceptance criteria: Given a category with a configured target of T hours and a request open for more than T hours in a non-terminal status, when the dashboard or queue is viewed, then that request is flagged overdue; and a request open for less than T hours is not flagged.
Verification method: Boundary test at T-1, T and T+1. NOTE: target values are not yet agreed - see RSK-05 and SCOPE-D-02.

Title: Export service activity
Requirement: A Manager shall export the filtered request list to CSV for offline analysis and record keeping.
Acceptance criteria: Given a filtered request list of n rows, when export is selected, then a CSV file is produced containing exactly n data rows with a header row and the same field values as displayed.

Title: Manage the controlled category list
Requirement: An Administrator shall create, rename and deactivate categories, and shall configure the target resolution time for each category.
Acceptance criteria: Given a category referenced by existing requests, when deactivation is attempted, then the category is deactivated for new submissions while existing requests retain it; and deletion that would orphan a request is refused.

Title: Manage users and roles
Requirement: An Administrator shall change a user's role and deactivate a user account.
Acceptance criteria: Given an active user with assigned open requests, when the account is deactivated, then the user can no longer sign in, the assigned requests remain visible to the Manager for reassignment, and the change is written to the audit trail.

Title: Immutable audit trail
Requirement: The system shall record every status change and every assignment change with the acting user, timestamp, previous value and new value, and shall not permit these records to be edited or deleted through the application.
Acceptance criteria: Given a request that has undergone k status or assignment changes, when the history is viewed, then exactly k ordered entries are shown each with actor, UTC timestamp, previous value and new value; and no application function exists that edits or deletes an entry.
Verification method: Functional test + code review + negative test (NFR-006)

Title: Duplicate submission prompt
Requirement: On submission the system shall warn the Requester when an open request with the same category and location already exists, while still permitting submission.
Acceptance criteria: Given an existing open request with category C and location L, when a Requester submits a new request with category C and location L, then a warning listing the possible duplicate is displayed and the Requester may confirm or cancel.
